_comment: Game build number -> patch version, for bump_replay.py.
The build is the int32 at offset 0x10 of an FFXIVREPLAY .dat, and is also
shown as 'game build' in the workbench inspector. FFXIVOpcodes' opcodes.json
does not carry build numbers, so this table is maintained by hand: record a
replay on a fresh patch, read its build, add a line here.
Keep in sync with BUILD_TO_PATCH / LATEST_GAME_BUILD in docs/opcodes.js.
This is only a hint. bump_replay.py reads the patch out of the recording's
own opcodes and prefers that when it fits exactly, because a wrong entry
here does not fail loudly -- every packet still gets remapped, just onto the
wrong packet type. Run with a .dat and it will tell you if a line is wrong.
